options.name: allhttpheaders
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log all the request and response headers.

options.name: analyticsauthtoken
options.description: Token for authenticating with the endpoint. If the endpoint requires the Authorization header in a particular format, specify the complete format as the value to this parameter. For eg., in case of splunk, the Authorizaiton header is required to be of the form - Splunk <auth-token>.

options.name: analyticsendpointcontenttype
options.description: By default, application/json content-type is used. If this needs to be overridden, specify the value.

options.name: analyticsendpointmetadata
options.description: If the endpoint requires some metadata to be present before the actual json data, specify the same.

options.name: analyticsendpointurl
options.description: The URL at which to upload the analytics data on the endpoint

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: auditlogs
options.description: This option indicates the whether auditlog should be sent to the REST collector.

options.name: collectors
options.description: The collector can be an IP, an appflow collector name, a service or a vserver. If IP is specified, the transport is considered as logstream and default port of 5557 is taken. If collector name is specified, the collector properties are taken from the configured collector. If service is specified, the configured service is assumed as the collector. If vserver is specified, the services bound to it are considered as collectors and the records are load balanced.

options.name: cqareporting
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log TCP CQA parameters.

options.name: dataformatfile
options.description: This option is for configuring the file containing the data format and metadata required by the analytics endpoint.

options.name: events
options.description: This option indicates the whether events should be sent to the REST collector.

options.name: grpcstatus
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log the gRPC status headers

options.name: httpauthentication
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log Authentication header.

options.name: httpclientsidemeasurements
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will insert a javascript into the HTTP response to collect the client side page-timings and will send the same to the configured collectors.

options.name: httpcontenttype
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log content-length header.

options.name: httpcookie
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log cookie header.

options.name: httpcustomheaders
options.description: Specify the list of custom headers to be exported in web transaction records.

options.name: httpdomainname
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log domain name.

options.name: httphost
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log the Host header in appflow records

options.name: httplocation
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log location header.

options.name: httpmethod
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log the method header in appflow records

options.name: httppagetracking
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will link the embedded objects of a page together.

options.name: httpreferer
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log the referer header in appflow records

options.name: httpsetcookie
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log set-cookie header.

options.name: httpsetcookie2
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log set-cookie2 header.

options.name: httpurl
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log the URL in appflow records

options.name: httpurlquery
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log URL Query.

options.name: httpuseragent
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log User-Agent header.

options.name: httpvia
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will Via header.

options.name: httpxforwardedforheader
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log X-Forwarded-For header.

options.name: integratedcache
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log the Integrated Caching appflow records

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managementlog
options.description: This option indicates the whether managementlog should be sent to the REST collector.

options.name: metrics
options.description: This option indicates the whether metrics should be sent to the REST collector.

options.name: metricsexportfrequency
options.description: This option is for configuring the metrics export frequency in seconds, frequency value must be in [30,300] seconds range

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the analytics profile. Must begin with an ASCII alphabetic or underscore (_) character, and must contain only ASCII alphanumeric, underscore, hash (#), period (.), space, colon (:), at (@), equals (=), and hyphen (-) characters.  The following requirement applies only to the Citrix ADC CLI: If the name includes one or more spaces, enclose the name in double or single quotation marks (for example, "my appflow profile" or 'my appflow profile').

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: outputmode
options.description: This option indicates the format of REST API POST body. It depends on the consumer of the analytics data.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: schemafile
options.description: This option is for configuring json schema file containing a list of counters to be exported by metricscollector

options.name: servemode
options.description: This option is for setting the mode of how data is provided

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(changed), the resource will be changed(?action=update) on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: tcpburstreporting
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will log TCP burst parameters.

options.name: topn
options.description: On enabling this topn support, the topn information of the stream identifier this profile is bound to will be exported to the analytics endpoint.

options.name: type
options.description: This option indicates what information needs to be collected and exported.

options.name: urlcategory
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will send the URL category record.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
